# A world-time bezel on your wrist.

> A Garmin Connect IQ watch face with a fixed 24-hour ring and 42 world cities placed at their current local hour. No permissions, no network.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
